question: Tell me about the TypeScript SDK nullable properties feature from January 14, 2025
ground_truth:
The January 14, 2025 TypeScript SDK release included the following changes:
- Version 0.47.0: Added support for nullable properties, allowing users to specify explicit null values for types that have nullable properties.
- Version 0.46.11: Fixed an issue where optional string literal aliases were double-checked when building query string parameters.
- Version 0.46.10: Fixed to use serialization layer to convert types to JSON strings when enabled.
